# Hash-pinned install set for ci.yml's "Install ruff (fast linter)" step.
#
# Direct requirements: ruff
#
# The lint job ("Syntax & Lint") runs on ubuntu-latest / CPython 3.9. It was
# installing this with a bare `pip install ruff`, so every run linted with
# whatever the index served that minute -- in the job whose whole purpose is
# to decide whether this repo's source is well-formed.
#
# ruff is a self-contained Rust binary wheel and declares no dependencies, so
# the whole closure is the one name.
#
# Installed with `pip install --require-hashes`, which refuses to install
# anything not listed here with a matching hash -- so the step gets the exact
# artifact this file names, or it fails.
#
# Each version lists the sha256 of EVERY distribution PyPI publishes for it
# (every platform wheel, plus the sdist), so the pin does not quietly depend
# on the runner resolving to the same artifact this file was generated
# against.
#
# The lint step is `ruff check ... || true` -- advisory, not a gate -- so a
# version move here changes what is REPORTED, never whether the job passes.
#
# Regenerate with:
#   uv pip compile --generate-hashes --python-version 3.9 --no-header \
#     -o .github/requirements/ci-lint-ruff.txt -   <<< 'ruff'
ruff==0.17.1 \
